name: Dip
spec: yellow diamond with black legend DIP
meaning: A dip in the road ahead; slow down.

snippets.back: Apparently shallow floodwater may hide a dip or a roadbed washed away underneath.
A DIP sign warns of a dip in the road and tells you to slow down.
Rural roads may have sharp or blind curves, steep hills and dips, poor or hidden guide signs, narrow lanes that make passing hard, and no shoulders or guard rails.
Distrust lingering bike blinkers, telegraph every move, gift room for pothole dodges, trail three to four seconds or longer when wet, dip beams, and hold course while being passed.
Use dipped beams when approaching or closely following another vehicle, under street lighting or in fog.
Condition plates refuse tall rigs at low spans, flag gravel, soft shoulders, slick bends, waterable dips, tight and single-file bridges, and gear-dropping hills.
A minor's school-related evidence may be a school-enrollment certificate, high-school diploma, special diploma, high-school-completion certificate or GED.
School compliance may be documented by a verification slip from an acceptable school or program the applicant attends, a high school diploma or a general-education completion certificate.
